question: Will SpaceX launch Starship from Florida before February 1, 2027?
description: Resolves YES if a full Starship stack (Super Heavy booster and Ship) lifts off from a Florida launch pad, at Kennedy Space Center or Cape Canaveral, before 00:00 UTC on February 1, 2027, whatever happens after liftoff; otherwise NO. Static fires and other tests without a liftoff do not count. FAA planning documents pointed to December 10, 2026 for this first Florida flight; SpaceX has not confirmed a date. Collateral: NEAR.
